stemMd:
A team predicts that adding a second layer of insulation will produce a smaller additional reduction in heat loss than adding the first layer.

| Layers | Heat loss (watts) |
|---:|---:|
| 0 | 90 |
| 1 | 54 |
| 2 | 40 |

Which statement best supports the prediction?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The first layer reduces heat loss by 36 watts, while the second reduces it by 14 watts.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The second layer increases heat loss by 14 watts.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Each layer reduces heat loss by 36 watts.

explanationMd: Marginal reduction is the difference between consecutive rows. The first change is 90−54=36; the next is 54−40=14. The smaller second difference supports diminishing additional benefit.
